judgment.notes: Cauchy–Schwarz applies to the finite-support nonnegative sequences, their shell restrictions and their shifted/reflected zero extensions. The shell-index shifts also preserve or decrease the relevant ell^2 norms. The geometric ratio 2^(-1/2) lies strictly between zero and one. These routine applications are justified in BG001–BG003. There are no E/M applications.
